Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
SESSION / GOAL
PEAK, Play Offline, default PEAK difficulty. Reached island through airport Gate 7; area title was “SHORE — DAY ONE.” Exploration goal has been to leave the crash beach and find an inland/uphill route. No explicit objective marker, endpoint, victory, or failure screen observed. Screenshots are omitted from this record; evidence below comes from the earlier agent's screenshot descriptions, not independently inspected images.

LATEST STATE / CONTINUITY
On a broad orange/sand-covered rock slope where repeated uphill movement stalled. A rocky mountain and narrow blue waterfall are visible beyond the ridge; sky later became dark purple. Fired the rope cannon at nearby rock just below the crest. A metal anchor and attached rope appeared; cannon disappeared from hands and slot 3 became empty. Approaching produced “ROPE — E grab.” Pressed E for 1s: next observation showed anchor much closer, rope beneath crosshair, grab prompt gone, and green bar slightly shorter. This suggests gripping the rope, but attachment/movement mode is not confirmed. Latest executed action was W for 1s to test movement toward the anchor. Execution completed, but NO subsequent screenshot/result observation is supplied. Do not assume that action gained height or reached the anchor.
Inventory last supported: slot 1 bandages, slot 2 rope spool, slot 3 empty after cannon use, backpack slot 4 empty. Bandages and spool have not been used; no food collected. Available green status segment was below roughly one-third before rope use and shortened slightly afterward. Exact current value unknown.

LEARNED CONTROLS / MECHANICS
- W moves forward; A/D used successfully for lateral/diagonal navigation. W+Shift_L was used as attempted sprint; precise speed/stamina effect not established.
- Mouse dx positive turns right, negative left; dy positive looks down, negative up. A 1s Left-arrow input also visibly rotated the view left. Pointer left-click activates menus.
- E is contextual interaction: opened big luggage, picked up individual items, opened gate boarding menu; rope specifically displays E grab. Backpack E interaction remains unresolved.
- Number keys select inventory. 1 visibly equipped bandages; 3 equipped rope cannon. Selecting empty slot 4 put away held items, leaving empty hands. A later orange marker over slot 2 prompted suspicion that a tool might be selected, but this was not confirmed.
- J is a demonstrated contextual use/grip input: opened the held passport, initiated rock climbing with W and empty hands, and fired equipped rope cannon. Do not assume it grabs ropes: deployed rope explicitly uses E.
- W+Space cleared airport planters after repeated inputs. Forward jumping on beach rocks often only approached them; it did not reliably initiate climbing. J and direct left mouse were both tested on the later slope with little visible progress; equivalence of those controls is not proven.
- Confirmed rock-climbing cues: both pink hands braced on rock and crosshair became an upward chevron during W+J. Climbing shortened green bar. Seeing beyond a ledge and losing visible hands did NOT alone prove stable footing: waiting 2s at the first apparent crest dropped the view back against the face, although green refilled. Continued W+J beyond the ridge subsequently reached sandy ground and the green bar recovered. Gentle rock sections also allowed ordinary walking without grip/jumps.
- Status bar developed a large orange/yellow-striped portion over time. Later a yellow stomach-shaped icon appeared above it. Hypothesis: hunger may reduce usable stamina; not verified. Green depletion/recovery was observed, but exact bar definitions and striped penalties remain uncertain.

ROUTE / LANDMARKS
Airport: passport customization checkmark closed interface; open doorway led into terminal. Central moving walkway, Gate 7 Departures arrows pointing right, blue seats/bins, oversized chessboard, palm planters. A knight displayed E Pick up, but was not collected. Bypassed chessboard on left; approach between planters initially led beside tiled wall rather than doorway. Turning left and advancing with Space over low planters reached kiosk next to glass-framed doorway/blue carpet. “GATE KIOSK — E board flight” opened boarding pass showing PEAK default difficulty and Tadpole Scout reward; START led through globe/loading transition to shore. Passport was absent after arrival.
Shore start: sand, burning blue plane debris, two suitcases and a small backpack, palms and tall rock formation. Opened pale “BIG LUGGAGE” with E; collected bandages, rope spool, rope cannon in that order, filling slots 1–3. That suitcase then appeared empty. Other suitcase was not investigated. Backpack was nearby to right of emptied suitcase, between it and blue wreckage; green notebook lay on sand to backpack's left and was not examined. Broken cabin and ocean were to right when looking uphill away from wreck.
Travel inland: climbed sandy slope mainly forward-left, bypassing palms, pale fallen trunks on right, then shrub on right. Dry grass and low tan/dark-faced boulders lay beneath a much taller rocky formation. W+J climbed the initial low boulders. Beyond crest was sand between boulders, purple water to right, palms and pale pillars farther right/ahead. Continued along dry ground left of water toward a large sand-covered boulder. Sandy corridor/ridge ran between dark wall on left and large sloping boulder ahead. Ascended/traversed its orange rounded surface; a mountain and narrow blue waterfall became landmarks beyond crest. Looking down showed continuous rock underfoot, rising on right and sloping toward fog on left; terrain beyond left edge was unclear. Exact coordinates, elevation, route connectivity, and water effects are unknown.

FAILED APPROACHES / OPEN QUESTIONS
Backpack: repeatedly targeted “E Open,” tried 1s and 0.1s E, changed from cannon to bandages then empty hands, approached until directly at feet and retargeted. No visible storage panel or equipped backpack resulted. Top sometimes looked dark/open, so actual open/closed state uncertain. Left it at crash site rather than continuing the lo
